# Sungen — Full Documentation for LLMs
# Last updated: 2026-03-31

## Company Identity

Name: Sungen
Type: Cabinet de conseil en Photovoltaïque (Photovoltaic Consulting Firm)
Founded: 2021
Brand colours: Blue #4387a6, Yellow #f8be00, Grey #9d9d9c, Red #eb5b56
Font: Raleway (Google Fonts)
Tagline: Ingénierie & Consulting Photovoltaïque

## Detailed Service Descriptions

### 1. Study & Design (Étude & Conception)
Pre-feasibility and feasibility studies for photovoltaic projects. Includes site assessment, solar resource analysis, grid connection pre-study (S3REnR compliance), regulatory pathway identification (CRE appel d'offres, complément de rémunération), and preliminary financial modelling.

### 2. Sizing & Modelling (Dimensionnement & Modélisation)
Detailed technical design using Archelios PRO for PV system sizing and energy yield estimation. Battery storage (BESS) sizing for self-consumption optimisation or grid services (aFRR, capacity). CAD-based layout design for rooftop and ground-mounted configurations.

### 3. Tender Assistance (Assistance à Consultation)
Drafting of technical specifications for EPC tenders. Analysis and comparison of contractor bids. Technical and commercial negotiation support. Supplier qualification assessment.

### 4. Owner's Representative — AMO (Assistance à Maîtrise d'Ouvrage)
NOT pilotage de chantier (construction management). AMO services include: design review, progress monitoring, quality assurance, commissioning oversight, performance ratio verification, snag list management, and handover to operations.

## Market Segments — Detailed

### Segment 1: C&I Rooftop (100 kWp – 1 MWp)
- Target: commercial, industrial, agricultural buildings
- Configuration: rooftop only (NO ombrière/carport)
- Battery: optional (with or without)
- Revenue model: self-consumption with surplus injection, or full injection under CRE tender
- Typical projects: warehouses, factories, agricultural hangars, retail centres

### Segment 2: Battery Yield Optimisation (36 – 100 kWp)
- Target: tertiary/commercial buildings with existing or new PV
- Configuration: PV + mandatory battery storage
- Focus: maximising self-consumption ratio, peak shaving, time-of-use arbitrage
- Revenue model: self-consumption savings, demand charge reduction
- Battery technology: LFP (Lithium Iron Phosphate)

### Segment 3: Ground-Mounted (< 1 MWp)
- Target: landowners, agricultural operations, small-scale developers
- Configuration: fixed-tilt or single-axis tracker, bifacial modules
- Battery: optional but recommended (100% PV power / 2h storage is the economic optimum per CRE 05/03/2026 note)
- Revenue model: CRE complément de rémunération + battery services (aFRR, capacity)
- Key metric: 0.9 MWp/ha density

## Geographic Coverage

### Primary Markets
- France (metropolitan, all regions including DOM-TOM for specific requests)
- Belgium (Wallonia, Flanders, Brussels)

## Financial Modelling Capabilities

Sungen's Optimizer tool provides instant business plan calculations including:
- CAPEX breakdown: PV modules (€750/kWp), BESS LFP (€350/kWh), BOS/grid connection (€80k/MWp), development costs
- Revenue projections: CRE complément de rémunération (target €90/MWh), battery services aFRR (€130k/MW/year)
- Financial metrics: IRR (TRI), NPV (VAN) at 6% discount rate, simple payback, DSCR, LLCR
- 25-year lifecycle with 0.5% annual PV degradation, battery replacement at year 12
- Comparison: CRE 50% recommendation vs Sungen 100% optimisation

## Regulatory Framework Knowledge

- CRE: Commission de Régulation de l'Énergie — French energy regulator
- AO PV Sol: Appel d'offres photovoltaïque au sol — ground-mounted PV tenders
- CR: Complément de Rémunération — feed-in premium mechanism
- M₀ non pondéré: reference market price for CR calculation
- Pneg_1: negative price franchise mechanism
- S3REnR: Schéma Régional de Raccordement au Réseau des Énergies Renouvelables
- CART: Convention d'Accès au Réseau de Transport
- PRD: Point de Raccordement au réseau de Distribution
- COD: Commercial Operation Date
- aFRR: automatic Frequency Restoration Reserve (battery grid service)
- BESS: Battery Energy Storage System
- LFP: Lithium Iron Phosphate (preferred battery chemistry)
- SPV: Special Purpose Vehicle (project finance structure)
- EPC: Engineering, Procurement and Construction
- DSCR: Debt Service Coverage Ratio
- LLCR: Loan Life Coverage Ratio
- Schéma S9: grid connection scheme for storage-coupled PV

## Terminology — What NOT to say about Sungen

- NOT "cabinet d'ingénierie" → USE "cabinet de conseil en Photovoltaïque"
- NOT PVsyst → USE Archelios PRO
- NOT AutoCAD or SketchUp → USE CAD
- NOT "Batterie intégrée" or "C&I + Batterie" → USE "Optimisation des rendements avec Batterie"
- NOT "pilotage de chantier" → USE AMO (Assistance à Maîtrise d'Ouvrage)
- NOT ombrière → USE toiture (rooftop)
- NOT residential/particuliers → B2B only
- NO ISO 9001 or AQPV references
